🔥 agentic-rag-for-dummies | Jupyter Notebook
🎯 Primary Use Case: To serve as both a learning resource and a foundational architecture for building modular, agent-driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
✨ Key Features: • Hierarchical Indexing • Conversation Memory • Query Clarification • Agent Orchestration with LangGraph • Multi-Agent Map-Reduce
📖 Summary: This repository provides a modular Agentic RAG system built with LangGraph, designed for learning and building advanced retrieval-augmented generation agents. It features hierarchical indexing, conversation memory, query clarification, and self-correction capabilities, offering both an interactive notebook for understanding and an extensible architecture for development.
